topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; annual acknowledgment of POL-05 by all staff and contractors with access; sanctions in each policy
evidence: Code of conduct; 2026 acknowledgment report; sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives the quarterly cyber risk report from the vCISO and approves the risk appetite each year
evidence: Audit committee minutes (2026-09-17 and prior quarters); risk appetite approval

control_description: POL-01 sets roles: COO as system owner, Security Manager as Cybersecurity Coordinator, Director of Gas Control as operations lead; OSA service manager named
evidence: POL-01; Coordinator designation to TSA; OSA contact schedules

control_description: Controllers qualified and trained under 192.631(h); security staff training plans; OT security training for control center staff
evidence: Training records (10 of 28 controllers sampled in P07); qualification records
gap: Compressor station technicians have no OT security training (POAM-015); OT security depends on 2 engineers (P01 R-047)
remediation: Station technician module; third OT security engineer (FY2027 budget)

control_description: Security duties in job descriptions and objectives; policy violations handled under POL-01 section 5
evidence: Job descriptions; performance objectives for the security team and Gas Control

control_description: OT asset inventory, network diagrams, and SCADA point database used to operate and secure the service
evidence: OT inventory export; diagram set; point database
gap: Inventory about 85% complete for field devices; firmware unknown for about 20% of RTUs and PLCs; diagrams incomplete for 3 stations (POAM-007)
remediation: Field inventory by area; reconcile lateral devices first

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies on the intranet; annual training; quarterly phishing simulations; shift briefings for controllers
evidence: Training completion; June 2026 phishing click rate 6.1%; shift briefing log

control_description: OSA notice duties (30 minutes) in the shift checklist; incident notices to lateral owners in both P08 runbooks; shipper notices and FERC postings
gap: No written system description or service commitments document for the lateral owners; OSA notice step added to runbooks only in 2026-09 (P01 R-041)
remediation: Draft the system description and service commitments; test the 30-minute notice in the 2026-11-17 exercise

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk appetite statements and objectives for public safety, reliability of firm service, and the operated laterals
Annual risk assessment per SP 800-30 with OT threat sources; system-level view for contract operations
evidence: P01 risk register; P07 RA-3 fully satisfied

control_description: Fraud controls over payments and refunds (CFO); business email compromise risk rated
gap: No documented fraud risk assessment covering the operations services (false reports, billing of OSA fees)
remediation: Add an operations services fraud scenario to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Management of change for SCADA and network changes; TSA amendment question being added to the MOC form
gap: Two 2025 permanent changes not filed as TSA plan amendments; model vendor updates bypass MOC (POAM-018, POAM-019)
remediation: MOC form update; staging slot for model updates

control_description: Annual control assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm under the TSA Cybersecurity Assessment Plan; MSSP monthly reports
evidence: P07 plan and results; TSA plan approval 2025-11-20
gap: Assessment schedule behind the one-third minimum before P07 (POAM-016)
remediation: Map P07 results to plan measures; quarterly schedule tracking

control_description: POA&M tracked monthly by the GRC lead; High items reported to the audit committee each quarter

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 baseline with tailoring in the SSP and mapped to TSA measures
General technology controls over the SCADA platform, DMZ, and identity provider
gap: Station HMIs not hardened; self-approval possible in the change tool (POAM-006)
remediation: Two-person approval in the change tool; station hardening with HMI replacement

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 (2026); standards STD-01 to STD-10 (some drafts)
gap: STD-02, STD-03, STD-04, STD-05, and STD-07 still in draft
remediation: Issue the standards on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Separate OT domain with no trust to business IT; MFA and session recording on the remote access gateway; individual logins at GCC and BCC HMIs
evidence: Gateway configuration; P07 AC-17, IA-2 results
gap: Password-only privileged logons at station HMIs; 40% of field devices past the reset schedule (POAM-004). Lateral RTUs are within the reset program
remediation: Phishing-resistant authenticators for gateway users; reset program with lateral devices first

control_description: OT accounts created from an approved request with Gas Control approval for HMI roles
evidence: P07 sample of 25 of 96 new OT accounts (no exceptions)

control_description: Role-based SCADA access; access reviews; removal at departure
gap: OT removal averages 5 business days; reviews annual, not quarterly; transfers keep SCADA roles; 9 OT domain administrators against 4 (POAM-001, POAM-002)
remediation: Same-day removal from the HR ticket; quarterly reviews; reduce administrators

control_description: Badge access and CCTV at the GCC and BCC control rooms; visitor logs; intrusion alarms at M&R stations
evidence: Badge reports; visitor logs; P07 PE-3 (11 of 12 satisfied)
gap: Keys to 2 M&R stations not changed after an unreturned key set (POAM-017)
remediation: Rekey; key return on the termination checklist

control_description: Media sanitization for business IT; OT media handled under POL-04
gap: No sanitization records process yet for OT equipment; 14 station HMIs will be retired in 2027
remediation: Add OT equipment to the sanitization procedure before the HMI replacement

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewall pairs and DMZ at the GCC and BCC; deny-by-default rules; remote access only through the gateway
evidence: 214 DMZ rules reviewed; inbound test blocked (P07)
gap: OEM cellular modem gave an unauthorized path into the shared SCADA network at Compressor Station 4 (POAM-003, Very High); temporary rules without expiry
remediation: Survey all units; route OEM data through the DMZ; automatic rule expiry

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: IPsec for DMZ-to-cloud and MPLS links; TLS for the customer activities website; data exports to lateral owners by secure file transfer
gap: Microwave backbone unencrypted until the 2027 refresh (P01 R-049)
remediation: Microwave encryption at the 2027 refresh

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Application allowlisting on GCC and BCC HMIs and engineering workstations; EDR on business IT; scan-before-connect for vendor media
evidence: P07 SI-3 (EICAR on 2 HMIs); allowlisting console
gap: Station HMI signatures more than 90 days old; 14 station HMIs on an unsupported operating system (POAM-012, POAM-014)
remediation: Offline signature process; HMI replacement

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability management with CISA KEV prioritization; OT quarterly patch windows with documented mitigations
gap: 6 KEV entries on OT past the mitigation timeline; inventory gaps (POAM-012, POAM-007)
remediation: Out-of-cycle OT window; monthly KEV review with Gas Control

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: MSSP 24x7 monitoring of the SIEM, EDR, and OT sensors at the GCC, BCC, and Compressor Stations 1 and 3
gap: No OT monitoring at 3 of 5 stations or field telecommunications; OT logs kept 90 days against 12 months (POAM-014, POAM-005)
remediation: Sensors at the 3 stations; 12-month write-once archive

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation to the OT Security Engineer and the shift supervisor within 15 minutes for OT alerts
evidence: Simulated BCC alert escalated in 11 minutes (P07)

control_description: TSA Cybersecurity Incident Response Plan; P08 runbooks 1 and 2; annual exercise; CISA reporting within 72 hours
evidence: Plan; 2025 exercise report; CISA reports (2 of 2)
gap: Decision criteria and lateral owner notices are in the new runbooks but not yet in the TSA plan; isolation never performed live (POAM-008, POAM-010)
remediation: Adopt runbooks into the TSA plan; live isolation drill

control_description: BCC hot standby; offline SCADA backups; restore procedures
gap: Full SCADA rebuild not tested in 12 months; recovery of both control centers not demonstrated (POAM-009)
remediation: Spare servers; bare-metal rebuild test

control_description: MOC with point-to-point verification for SCADA changes (192.631(c)(2)); change tool with approvals
gap: 3 changes without point-to-point records; self-approval possible (POAM-006)
remediation: Block release without a P2P record; two-person approval

control_description: BIA with MTDs and RTOs; manual operation plan; BCC; cyber insurance; operate-or-shut-down criteria in P08
evidence: P05 BIA; P08 runbooks; insurance policy
gap: Criteria not yet adopted into the TSA plan; executives defaulted to shutdown in the 2025 tabletop (POAM-008)
remediation: Executive tabletop with the board chair; adoption into the plan

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor tiers; security addendum; annual Tier 1 SOC 2 reviews (Part B)
gap: 10 of 14 Tier 1 vendors not assessed in 12 months; about 40% of contracts lack security terms; telecom carrier and SCADA software vendor are subservice organizations for this service without reports (POAM-013)
remediation: Complete Tier 1 reviews; STD-03; addenda at renewal

control_description: SCADA server and telecom capacity monitored; redundant SCADA servers; satellite backup at 12 critical sites
Hot-standby BCC; UPS and generators at the GCC and BCC; weekly SCADA backups and monthly offline copies at the BCC
evidence: Backup logs (30 of 30 days, July 2026); generator test records
gap: PLC logic backups missing at 3 stations; separate BCC administrative credentials not in place (POAM-009)
remediation: Collect and hash PLC logic; separate BCC credentials

control_description: Annual BCC failover (192.631(c)(4)); manual operation communication test
gap: Failover tested, but a full rebuild has not been (POAM-009); lateral owners have not taken part in a test
remediation: Rebuild test; invite lateral owners to the 2026-11-04 failover test window

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classifies lateral owner operating data and SCADA configuration as Confidential or Restricted; stored only on the OT network and approved locations
gap: 11 unmarked SSI copies found on a general share shows marking drift (POAM-011); lateral owner data not yet tagged in the data inventory
remediation: Data loss rule; tag lateral data

control_description: Retention and disposal under POL-04; OSA exit terms
gap: No written procedure to return or delete lateral owner data at OSA end
remediation: Add exit procedure to the OSA service commitments

control_description: OSAs define the monitored points, alarm limits, and reports for each lateral; control room procedures apply
gap: Processing commitments are spread across the OSAs and not written in one system description
remediation: Write processing commitments into the system description

control_description: Lateral field data validated by point-to-point checks at commissioning and after changes; data quality alarms
gap: Point-to-point records missing for 3 system changes (POAM-006); none affected lateral points
remediation: Release blocked without a P2P record

control_description: Alarm management under 192.631(e); controllers act on lateral alarms under the owners' procedures
evidence: Alarm management plan; annual alarm review

control_description: Daily operating reports and alarm summaries sent to each lateral owner; reviewed by the shift supervisor
Historian retention and backups for lateral data; replica in the OT analytics cloud account
